title: fix(examples): lay out the inert internal create/edit forms as fieldGroups and drop their advisory allowlist rows
body:
Fixes #36553

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 展示应用和 CRM 示例里,项目、业务单元、联系人、线索、活动五类记录的新建与编辑表单改由对象自己的字段分组排版。分区和以前手写的表单一致;联系人新建只问姓名、邮箱、电话、公司。
- 平台已不再读取对象内部的新建/编辑表单,示例里却还留着这些失效写法,会被作者和 AI 照抄。本次属于「内部表单退役」的收尾。
- 只影响两个示例应用的表单分区,不碰平台代码和数据;出问题可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

The examples still declared internal create/edit forms that the Console stopped loading with the internal-form retirement (#36425). Each form's sections become the object's `fieldGroups`, and the inert forms are deleted.

**examples/app-showcase**
- `showcase_project`: new `fieldGroups` `project` (name, account, status, health, owner) and `budget_schedule` (budget, spent, start_date, end_date), written as group `fields` lists. The five fields the old form never listed (budget_remaining, labels, team_members, task_count, total_estimate) fall into the trailing untitled section. They render there today too, flat, because the form has been inert since #36425.
- `showcase_business_unit`: new `fieldGroups` `unit` (all five fields).
- `showcase_contact`: it already had the four groups. `showOnCreate: false` now goes on the five fields the sparse create form left out (title, account, stage, lead_score, notes), so create asks for name, email, phone and company, as before. The header comment and the object `description` (and its zh-CN mirror) stop teaching the sparse create override.
- `ui/views/{project,business-unit,contact}.view.ts`: the default `form` and contact's `formViews.create` are deleted. The `showcase_task` form stays: three `type: 'form'` actions open it by name (#36545).
- `system/translations/index.ts`: `_sections.who_is_this` and `_views.create` (its title and thank-you `submitBehavior`) are removed from the contact block. The `_sections` comments for project, business_unit and contact now name `fieldGroups` as their source.
- `test/author-time-advisories.test.ts`: the 4 `form-view-internal-not-loaded` rows and the `INERT_INTERNAL_FORM` reason are removed. The section comment keeps the task-form explanation.
- `test/seed.test.ts`: the two contact pins are re-anchored. The first holds `_sections` equal to the object's derived group keys and `_views` equal to `default`. The second pins the four derived edit sections with their members, the create projection (name, email, phone, company), and that the container declares no `form` or `formViews`.
- `coverage.ts`: no change. `task.view.ts` alone covers simple, tabbed and wizard, and no form type's only coverage was a deleted form.

**examples/app-crm**
- `crm_lead`: new `fieldGroups` lead_information, qualification, conversion and notes, as group `fields` lists. The list keeps the form's order (company second) without moving field declarations. Field definitions are unchanged, so the public Web-to-Lead resolve stays byte-equal.
- `crm_activity`: new `fieldGroups` activity_details, related_records and notes.
- `crm_opportunity`: it already declares the same `opportunity` group (every field) plus `lines`, so only the form is deleted.
- `test/i18n-sections.test.ts`: the sweep now covers every titled `fieldGroups` heading as well as named form sections. Its vacuity guard holds each sweep separately: at least 1 form section and at least 10 group headings, including lead, opportunity and activity.

**Authorized beyond the examples (surface amendment on the card, option A)**
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-section-coverage.test.ts`, the "showcase app, walked for real" pin only: it passes `Contact` beside `ContactViews` and expects the four contact group keys without `who_is_this`.
- Mechanical consequences of that pin's new read: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/contact.object.ts` is declared as a cli test input in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and in `turbo.json` (`@objectstack/cli#test`). `check:cross-package-test-inputs` goes red without both.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json` (`access-security.fls-mask-and-strip`, revision 9) and `areas/i18n.json` (`i18n.surface-matrix`, revision 17): the steps, the clause and the known gap that read the deleted forms now read the field groups. Each item gets a new history entry. The older history entries are kept as dated records, not rewritten.
- `content/docs/ui/field-grouping-and-order.mdx`: one runnable-example line said `contact.view.ts` holds "sections that materialise those groups". The view no longer has them, so the line says it is the list and declares no form.

No changeset: both examples are `private: true`, and `packages/cli` publishes only `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, never `test/`. Labelled `skip-changeset`.

<details><summary>Ablation of the create-projection pin</summary>

I removed `showOnCreate: false` from contact `title` and `account` on disk and ran `seed.test.ts -t 'lays the contact'`: lock VERDICT command-exit 1, `expected [ 'name', 'email', 'phone', …(3) ] to deeply equal [ 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'company' ]` (+ title, + account). I then restored the file from HEAD (`git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree`), and the porcelain status was clean.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 103 families)</summary>

`dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation: 103 derived, 100 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The three NOT MEASURED exited 3 on a prerequisite this worktree lacks, and none of them reads these files: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its pinned commit is not in the shallow clone), `spec check:skill-examples` (client-react has no build), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (no repo-wide dist). CI runs all three. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` went red until `turbo.json` declared the new input, then OK. The others include `check:platform-checklist` OK (448 items), `check:i18n-coverage` OK (none new), `check:examples-live-imports` OK, `check:nul-bytes` OK, `check:turbo-task-graph` OK and `check:issue-citations` exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `columns: 2` on the old sections, and the contact create form's `title: 'New contact'` and thank-you `submitBehavior`, have no `fieldGroups` equivalent and are dropped. All of them were already inert.
- Noted, not fixed: `i18n.surface-matrix` still describes the task's New/Edit form as "its default form's `task` section". Since #36425 the task's New/Edit is also laid out by its field groups, and its default form loads only where a form action opens it. This card did not touch that, and it was already stale before.
- Noted, not fixed: the comment above `describe('validateTranslationReferences — the showcase contact surface (#5415)')` in packages/lint says the contact object declares no `fieldGroups[]`. That has been stale since #5443 and is outside this card's packages surface. The tests pass.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `examples/app-showcase/test/seed.test.ts`: the two re-anchored contact pins. They replace a comparison against the deleted form.
2. `examples/app-crm/test/i18n-sections.test.ts`: the extended sweep and its split vacuity guard.
3. `packages/cli/test/i18n-section-coverage.test.ts`: the one authorized hunk.

Two-minute check: `grep -n "form-view-internal-not-loaded" examples/app-showcase/test/author-time-advisories.test.ts` prints nothing.
